WITH CTE1 
AS(
SELECT convert(NUMERIC(25,5),COUNT(*)) COUNT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT1)),0) AMOUNT1_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT2)),0) AMOUNT2_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT3)),0) AMOUNT3_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT4)),0) AMOUNT4_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT5)),0) AMOUNT5_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT6)),0) AMOUNT6_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT7)),0) AMOUNT7_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT8)),0) AMOUNT8_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT9)),0) AMOUNT9_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT10)),0) AMOUNT10_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT11)),0) AMOUNT11_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT12)),0) AMOUNT12_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),ANNUALREVENUE)),0) ANNUALREVENUE_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AVAILABLECRLIMIT)),0) AVAILABLECRLIMIT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),CURRENTCREXPOSURE)),0) CURRENTCREXPOSURE_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),CUSTOMERPROFITABILITY)),0) CUSTOMERPROFITABILITY_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),OFFLINE_CUM_DEBIT_LIMIT)),0) OFFLINE_CUM_DEBIT_LIMIT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),POTENTIALCRLINE)),0) POTENTIALCRLINE_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),TOTALCREXPOSURE)),0) TOTALCREXPOSURE_tgt

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM 
FROM d360.STG_EDS_CRM_ACCOUNTS WHERE H = 'D'
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM
)
,
CTE2 AS (
SELECT REPLACE(H,'F-','') COUNT_src
, convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT1) AMOUNT1_src
, convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT2) AMOUNT2_src
, convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT3) AMOUNT3_src
, convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT4) AMOUNT4_src
, convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT5) AMOUNT5_src
, convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT6) AMOUNT6_src
, convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT7) AMOUNT7_src
, convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT8) AMOUNT8_src
, convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT9) AMOUNT9_src
, convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT10) AMOUNT10_src
, convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT11) AMOUNT11_src
, convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT12) AMOUNT12_src
, convert(NUMERIC(25,5),ANNUALREVENUE) ANNUALREVENUE_src
, convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AVAILABLECRLIMIT) AVAILABLECRLIMIT_src
, convert(NUMERIC(25,5),CURRENTCREXPOSURE) CURRENTCREXPOSURE_src
, convert(NUMERIC(25,5),CUSTOMERPROFITABILITY) CUSTOMERPROFITABILITY_src
, convert(NUMERIC(25,5),OFFLINE_CUM_DEBIT_LIMIT) OFFLINE_CUM_DEBIT_LIMIT_src
, convert(NUMERIC(25,5),POTENTIALCRLINE) POTENTIALCRLINE_src
, convert(NUMERIC(25,5),TOTALCREXPOSURE) TOTALCREXPOSURE_src

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.STG_EDS_CRM_ACCOUNTS WHERE H <> 'D'
)
,
CTE12 as (
SELECT COUNT_SRC, COUNT_TGT
, AMOUNT1_tgt
, AMOUNT2_tgt
, AMOUNT3_tgt
, AMOUNT4_tgt
, AMOUNT5_tgt
, AMOUNT6_tgt
, AMOUNT7_tgt
, AMOUNT8_tgt
, AMOUNT9_tgt
, AMOUNT10_tgt
, AMOUNT11_tgt
, AMOUNT12_tgt
, ANNUALREVENUE_tgt
, AVAILABLECRLIMIT_tgt
, CURRENTCREXPOSURE_tgt
, CUSTOMERPROFITABILITY_tgt
, OFFLINE_CUM_DEBIT_LIMIT_tgt
, POTENTIALCRLINE_tgt
, TOTALCREXPOSURE_tgt
, AMOUNT1_src
, AMOUNT2_src
, AMOUNT3_src
, AMOUNT4_src
, AMOUNT5_src
, AMOUNT6_src
, AMOUNT7_src
, AMOUNT8_src
, AMOUNT9_src
, AMOUNT10_src
, AMOUNT11_src
, AMOUNT12_src
, ANNUALREVENUE_src
, AVAILABLECRLIMIT_src
, CURRENTCREXPOSURE_src
, CUSTOMERPROFITABILITY_src
, OFFLINE_CUM_DEBIT_LIMIT_src
, POTENTIALCRLINE_src
, TOTALCREXPOSURE_src

, A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) DATE FROM CTE1 A
JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
)


--INSERT INTO [EDS].[EDS_HASH_LOG_TBL]
SELECT 
FILE_NAME
,DATE
,insert_dttm
,REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') METRICS
,SRC
,TGT 

FROM
(
SELECT 
 CAST(COUNT_SRC AS NUMERIC(25,5)) COUNT_SRC
,CAST(COUNT_TGT AS NUMERIC(25,5)) COUNT_TGT
,CAST(AMOUNT1_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT1_tgt
,CAST(AMOUNT2_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT2_tgt
,CAST(AMOUNT3_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT3_tgt
,CAST(AMOUNT4_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT4_tgt
,CAST(AMOUNT5_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT5_tgt
,CAST(AMOUNT6_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT6_tgt
,CAST(AMOUNT7_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT7_tgt
,CAST(AMOUNT8_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT8_tgt
,CAST(AMOUNT9_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT9_tgt
,CAST(AMOUNT10_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT10_tgt
,CAST(AMOUNT11_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT11_tgt
,CAST(AMOUNT12_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT12_tgt
,CAST(ANNUALREVENUE_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) ANNUALREVENUE_tgt
,CAST(AVAILABLECRLIMIT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AVAILABLECRLIMIT_tgt
,CAST(CURRENTCREXPOSURE_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CURRENTCREXPOSURE_tgt
,CAST(CUSTOMERPROFITABILITY_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CUSTOMERPROFITABILITY_tgt
,CAST(OFFLINE_CUM_DEBIT_LIMIT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) OFFLINE_CUM_DEBIT_LIMIT_tgt
,CAST(POTENTIALCRLINE_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) POTENTIALCRLINE_tgt
,CAST(TOTALCREXPOSURE_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) TOTALCREXPOSURE_tgt
,CAST(AMOUNT1_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT1_src
,CAST(AMOUNT2_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT2_src
,CAST(AMOUNT3_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT3_src
,CAST(AMOUNT4_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT4_src
,CAST(AMOUNT5_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT5_src
,CAST(AMOUNT6_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT6_src
,CAST(AMOUNT7_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT7_src
,CAST(AMOUNT8_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT8_src
,CAST(AMOUNT9_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT9_src
,CAST(AMOUNT10_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT10_src
,CAST(AMOUNT11_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT11_src
,CAST(AMOUNT12_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT12_src
,CAST(ANNUALREVENUE_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) ANNUALREVENUE_src
,CAST(AVAILABLECRLIMIT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AVAILABLECRLIMIT_src
,CAST(CURRENTCREXPOSURE_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CURRENTCREXPOSURE_src
,CAST(CUSTOMERPROFITABILITY_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CUSTOMERPROFITABILITY_src
,CAST(OFFLINE_CUM_DEBIT_LIMIT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) OFFLINE_CUM_DEBIT_LIMIT_src
,CAST(POTENTIALCRLINE_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) POTENTIALCRLINE_src
,CAST(TOTALCREXPOSURE_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) TOTALCREXPOSURE_src
,FILE_NAME
,INSERT_DTTM
,[DATE]
FROM CTE12
) pvt

UNPIVOT
(
SRC FOR METRICS IN (COUNT_SRC
, AMOUNT1_src
, AMOUNT2_src
, AMOUNT3_src
, AMOUNT4_src
, AMOUNT5_src
, AMOUNT6_src
, AMOUNT7_src
, AMOUNT8_src
, AMOUNT9_src
, AMOUNT10_src
, AMOUNT11_src
, AMOUNT12_src
, ANNUALREVENUE_src
, AVAILABLECRLIMIT_src
, CURRENTCREXPOSURE_src
, CUSTOMERPROFITABILITY_src
, OFFLINE_CUM_DEBIT_LIMIT_src
, POTENTIALCRLINE_src
, TOTALCREXPOSURE_src
)
) pvt1

UNPIVOT
(
TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT
, AMOUNT1_tgt
, AMOUNT2_tgt
, AMOUNT3_tgt
, AMOUNT4_tgt
, AMOUNT5_tgt
, AMOUNT6_tgt
, AMOUNT7_tgt
, AMOUNT8_tgt
, AMOUNT9_tgt
, AMOUNT10_tgt
, AMOUNT11_tgt
, AMOUNT12_tgt
, ANNUALREVENUE_tgt
, AVAILABLECRLIMIT_tgt
, CURRENTCREXPOSURE_tgt
, CUSTOMERPROFITABILITY_tgt
, OFFLINE_CUM_DEBIT_LIMIT_tgt
, POTENTIALCRLINE_tgt
, TOTALCREXPOSURE_tgt
)
) pvt2
 
WHERE cast(REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') as varchar(100)) = cast(REPLACE(METRICS2,'_TGT','') as varchar(100));
